steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Here you are.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Nearl.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You don't return to the landship often. Stay with Liz a bit; she's missed you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: She just fell asleep.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: While you seem more exhausted than when I last saw you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you worried about Liz? I asked Dr. Kal'tsit, and she said Liz's condition is still under control—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Is there... something you haven't told me?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm thinking... of a way to 'cure' Liz for good.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You've poured years into this, it just won't come quickly, so don't torture yourself over it.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What if... I told you a solution has always existed, only I've dared not try it?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What exactly are you hiding from me? What is it you can't say?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Nearl, this is a duty I must see through on my own.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you think Liz and I will leave you?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You know that won't happen.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: My concern... has always been that you two might get hurt.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I've decided to join Liz in searching for her memories. I shall accompany her... until we find the truth. However...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Nearl—

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: A time will come when I need you to protect Liz in my stead.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But I will protect and fight... for more than just Liz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining, I will stand for you as well.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We have always stood by each other. The Followers are as one.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: My oath remains, unchanged—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Margaret Nearl and her swordstaff will be there for you, whenever needed.
The swordstaff sweeps wide.
A dazzling radiance repels a crowd of foes.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Every single Confessarius here... is a powerful foe.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: So that's why you weren't willing to spar with me, Shining.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We saved quite a lot of money for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Our greatest foe... lies ahead.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Let's settle this quickly.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: What a farce!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: *huff*—Hah.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I can take it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining, my shield will protect you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You need only... advance.
A torrent of witchcraft washes toward them.
Margaret's radiance is suppressed.
Qui'sartuštaj stands on the top of the steps, day and night surging within his palm.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: So this is the help you found? Qui'saršinnag, what do you think our ceremonial altar is?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: A... meadow? For a Kuranta to frolic in?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Hmph, so her Arts can momentarily block my influence on you.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: And what of it? Your swordplay and Arts all come from me.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You can't even harm me... unless I let you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—Ugh!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Everything's slowed down...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: His Arts... affect the perception of time? Or is it something else...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...I'm alright.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Your shield...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...The first crack on this new shield of mine.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But no matter, I can mend it with my Arts.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: A knight's shield will never weaken when protecting someone in need.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: What a detestable light.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Puny foal, I've killed so many pegasi like you... I've stopped counting.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I smeared their golden blood on the walls of my Kazdel—so that my city would look as if forever bathed in the radiance of dawn.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: And their descendants would understand Kazdel is not a domain they can invade as they please.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We're not in Kazdel.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: And you're not some homeland hero either.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Heroes shed their own blood to clear the way for others.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But you—All I see is your path to ascension drenched with the blood, tears and bones of others.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Heroes? I decided long ago to give up being one.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: The hero people sing and praise... but is as fleeting as sand. No matter how I try to master the time I have, it does not stop for me.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I will die, and the city I built will collapse. My beloved people will only be compelled to continue wandering.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: This hopeless cycle... torments every single Sarkaz, including me.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: As a sovereign, I have the responsibility and power, and ought to change my people's fate at the source.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: As long as the Sarkaz need no longer lie prostrate before beasts like you, as long as my Kazdel stands everlasting through days and nights—
All the light around them rushes toward Qui'sartuštaj's palm as he speaks.
Margaret's Arts, the Arts of the other Confessarii, and even... the little sunlight straining through the dense clouds.
In his palm floats a small crown of thorns, as impenetrable as the darkest night.
Nightingale floats up from the stone bed.
Her eyes are still shut, her limbs lack strength, but her arms involuntarily open—
When the last light has been caged, the crown will fall on Qui'sartuštaj's head.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz...!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining, follow my light! Save her—
A sharp spear of light tears a path through the witchcraft barrier.
Shining arrives before Qui'sartuštaj.
Night descends like a cage, and the only light comes from her blade.
The soul glimmers on the tip of her sword.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I return the true memories I once took from you.

a.text: No fields, no woods, no streams... and no flower wreaths.
Only a girl huddled in a dark corner.
The entire room serves as her cage, and she cannot tell day from night.
Because she is merely a manufactured, empty shell.
With no consciousness, or knowledge of pain or fear. she reacts to no Arts inflicted on her at all.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: In my obsession with exploring the soul... I left some... unnecessary vestiges in you when carving yours.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're... awake.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're starting to have emotions, and responding to them.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The experiment will continue, I have to...

a.text: Create some illusions. Fill up that newborn soul with memories fabricated by Arts.
To cover up the truest, scariest ones.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I think you should feel a little better, at least.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You will feel truly alive, as if you've experienced... a bit of warmth.

a.text: As long as I lost myself in those wholly trusting eyes, I didn't have to confront the cruelty of what I'd done to her.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You should have remembered... Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You must remember all that we promised each other.
A blue fowlbeast emerges from the darkness.
Gigantic grey-white eyes stare at Shining, and a tear slowly falls.
The girl in the air floats down.
Shining and Margaret hear Nightingale's voice simultaneously in the frozen time.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I remember, Shining.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You took me out of the darkest of rooms and we escaped... you accompanied me everywhere in search of medical help...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: And then we met Nearl, and two became three.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: We went many places, and saved many people.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You often sighed with knitted brows in the middle of the night... but once I opened my eyes, you shifted to the warmest tone I know and told me about the beautiful things I missed on our journey.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Nearl tried to teach me how to dance a few times. She'd hold me and spin... until I couldn't move anymore, and the two of you would help me, taking turns carrying me...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: When I'm at your side...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: It's as if... I really can fly.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: The two of you have made me what I am now.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I am a member of the Followers... and a healer.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I'll protect you both too.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: And fight alongside as well, to sever the gravest sins, to save... those shrouded in the eternal night.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: This is what the three of us...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: ...Promised each other.
Nightingale lands on the ground.
Her staff and body emit an intense light.
A giant cage appears, and catches Qui'sartuštaj's body within.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: The soul was completely under my control, why is this cage—

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I have a name.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I am Liz—and I am your enemy.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Qui'sartuštaj, I'm stopping you because... I don't agree with a single word you've said.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Shining, Nearl...
Shining grips her sword tight.
Margaret tosses her swordstaff, and it hits right on target, the crown of thorns revolving in Qui'sartuštaj's hand.
The trio are in complete sync with their thoughts and actions.
Grab the flickering sliver of the soul, before day and night take control once more.
A long path of blood is the only crack before her eyes.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I've found it, the essence of your soul.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag... you...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What this body will become... I am unconcerned.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: If blood does control my will, then Liz and Nearl will pass judgement on me, in my stead as I am now.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But I will not be your puppet.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I will not conquer or rule in your name.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Until death... I will be free.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Free? You speak of freedom?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Shall we give it a go?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag, we are not easily parted.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Try again... to leave my side. Try and see... how long you can run from me.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I will run no longer.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Rather, I will—grant you an eternal death.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining—Retreat!
The moonlight above the tree tumbles down the cliff, and the ground violently rumbles as if about to turn upside down.
The altar crumbles, and thick golden Originium liquid gushes out from the cracks.
A figure appears without anyone noticing. He does not move fast, but manages to appear just in time to block Qui'sartuštaj from the Followers.

steps.name: Qalid'čoa
steps.text: We should leave....

steps.name: Qalid'čoa
steps.text: ...Your Highness.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Heh... So it's you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Who's there—?!

steps.name: Qalid'čoa
steps.text: Followers... is it?

steps.name: Qalid'čoa
steps.text: In this era where valor is scarce, your radiance bedazzles.

steps.name: Qalid'čoa
steps.text: We shall meet again.
Qalid'čoa and Qui'sartuštaj's figures blend into the remains of the altar.
The other Confessarii follow suit.
The crown of thorns shot out of Qui'sartuštaj's hand earlier suddenly spins, and turns into a pitch-black shadow that flies up toward the sky.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...The Shard.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: In the eye of the storm... is that the 'Amnannam' mentioned over the comms?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, the Doctor, and the others... will they make it?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining, you... uh, anything feel off?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm alright.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: This blood curse is indeed complicated.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Wait, Liz... Liz?!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Your soul... why is it incomplete?!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Did you fracture your soul... when you resisted Qui'sartuštaj?!

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Shining... Nearl...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've always been here, Liz.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I'm alright...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You two have protected me for so long... so it's my turn...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I want... the three of us... to be always...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Liz!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Come, Shining! We'll treat her together!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's futile.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Our Arts can't heal such a grievous wound on her soul in this environment.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz is unique, both her body and soul. Her birth was coincidental... no, I would rather call it a miracle.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Then we...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Will first leave this place, and then plan our next move.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What about Qui'sartuštaj? Do we just let him go?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: His fate means nothing compared to Liz's safety—he means nothing now.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Let us return.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes, together.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: ...Leader.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Furious roaring)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Qui'sartuštaj failed to cage the Black Crown.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The altar's power has weakened... I can work through its influence now—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The altar's upper layer is breaking apart. Amiya, focus your attacks on the Blood of Teekaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Hmm... Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz has already sentenced me to death.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: But this is nothing new to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're clearly... in pain.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You revere Qui'sartuštaj, but he left you behind like nothing. He treats you just like how you treat those Chimeras... exactly the same.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Don't waste your breath, King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: My feelings are nothing special.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: The Confessarii are of the Leader's blood. Though some are born more perfect than others... like Qui'saršinnag. Still others like myself were never in the running to be chosen at all.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: But I've never envied her.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: We only stand in the spot befitting us best.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: We were supposed to be inseparable. We are all limbs... of the same one body.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: There is no other group able to perform unprecedented miracles like we Confessarii can.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I am curious.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Is there nothing you're strongly attached to?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Doctor... Would you not make the same choice as I have, for your life's work, for those dear to you, and the ones who have fought by your side this whole time?

spans.text: Would you not make the same choice as I have, for your life's work, for those dear to you, and the ones who have fought by your side this whole time?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Whether it be under some control or influence... it does not matter.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: To reach our origin, and create a completely new future.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: That's all I want.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't... let you get close to the Blood of Teekaz.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Hah... Oh.
A black line pierces through Salus's body once again and strikes the altar's core at the same time.
The Blood of Teekaz stills.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I'm so close... ngh.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, stop her!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's going to ignite—

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: It's fine, it's fine...

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: My body... is just like a monster's...
She stretches out her broken hand towards that drop of blood.
A curse known only to the Confessarii, inflicted upon the soul, upon all blood and flesh—

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: It will probably be a complete death this time.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Before the Leader, before Qui'saršinnag, and before all my family...

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I'll take the first step... into the future I yearn for.
Salus smiles and throws herself onto the still heart.
The Blood of Teekaz boils.
A giant crimson vortex appears from the altar's core—
In that moment, Amiya feels as if she's being watched.
By Qui'sartuštaj, by the crowned without names, by the howling myriad souls... and the one she is most familiar with.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amnannam.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Salus used her own blood to complete the Confessarius ceremony.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Quick, get away from the altar!
